description.value: Blacktail is a casual fine dining restaurant and Bake+Brew Cafe in Daajing Giids on Haida Gwaii, founded in 2019 and drawing both locals and tourists. The menu leans into local ingredients — Haida Gwaii halibut and salmon feature prominently — alongside creative cocktails and an extensive list of BC and international wines. A harbour-facing patio overlooking the heart of downtown makes it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry.

address.value: 3207 Wharf Way, Daajing Giids, Haida Gwaii

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address (3207 Wharf Way), phone (604-762-5742), and email. Vegetarian dishes are confirmed via the food menu (Mushroom Pasta, Arrabbiata Pasta) and supported by OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes; diet:vegan=no is noted in OSM but not explicitly stated on the website. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Tu-Sa 17:00-21:00) does not match website, which lists two distinct operations: Blacktail Restaurant (Wed-Sun 5pm-close) and Blacktail Bake+Brew Cafe (Tue-Sat 8am-2pm). OSM hours appear outdated or incomplete — website should be considered authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and recent OSM check date (2024-07-30). A notable dining destination in a small remote community on Haida Gwaii.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates as two combined concepts under one roof: the evening fine-dining restaurant and a daytime Bake+Brew Cafe. The OSM record captures only the restaurant side.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu confirms multiple vegetarian large plates (Mushroom Pasta, Arrabbiata Pasta); GF not mentioned
